scope: Effective checked-in primary migrations plus beta compatibility columns and beta diagnostics SQL, applied to disposable SQLite; no live provider observation or independent acceptance

primary.name: devices
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE devices (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  public_key_spki_b64 TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at INTEGER,
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  last_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
, last_health_at INTEGER, health_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', recovery_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pending_records INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, app_version TEXT)

primary.name: pairing_tokens
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE pairing_tokens (
  token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  consumed_at INTEGER
)

primary.name: device_events
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(device_id, epoch, sequence)
)

primary.name: idx_device_events_device_time
primary.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_device_events_device_time ON device_events(device_id, created_at DESC)

primary.name: idx_pairing_expiry
primary.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_pairing_expiry ON pairing_tokens(expires_at)

primary.name: device_health_events
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_health_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

primary.name: idx_device_health_events_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_device_health_events_device_time
  ON device_health_events(device_id, created_at DESC)

primary.name: safety_events
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE safety_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  server_created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  latitude REAL,
  longitude REAL,
  accuracy_m REAL,
  detail_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
)

primary.name: idx_safety_events_device_time
primary.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_safety_events_device_time ON safety_events(device_id, server_created_at DESC)

primary.name: idx_safety_events_kind_time
primary.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_safety_events_kind_time ON safety_events(kind, server_created_at DESC)

primary.name: geofences
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE geofences (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  latitude REAL NOT NULL,
  longitude REAL NOT NULL,
  radius_m REAL NOT NULL CHECK(radius_m >= 25 AND radius_m <= 5000),
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
)

primary.name: idx_geofences_device
primary.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_geofences_device ON geofences(device_id, enabled)

primary.name: geofence_state
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE geofence_state (
  geofence_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  stable_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
  candidate_state TEXT,
  candidate_since INTEGER,
  candidate_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_distance_m REAL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  FOREIGN KEY(geofence_id) REFERENCES geofences(id),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
)

primary.name: idx_geofence_state_device
primary.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_geofence_state_device ON geofence_state(device_id, updated_at)

primary.name: trips
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE trips (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL,
  destination_name TEXT,
  destination_latitude REAL,
  destination_longitude REAL,
  destination_radius_m REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 120,
  expected_arrival_at INTEGER,
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ended_at INTEGER,
  arrival_candidate_since INTEGER,
  arrival_candidate_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_alert_at INTEGER,
  stationary_since INTEGER,
  last_stop_alert_at INTEGER,
  last_eval_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_eval_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_distance_to_destination_m REAL,
  last_location_at INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
)

primary.name: idx_trips_device_state
primary.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_trips_device_state ON trips(device_id, state, started_at DESC)

primary.name: retention_settings
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE retention_settings (
  device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  safety_event_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 180 CHECK(safety_event_days BETWEEN 30 AND 3650),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
)

primary.name: device_health_samples
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_health_samples (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  service_active INTEGER NOT NULL,
  location_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
  location_subscribed INTEGER NOT NULL,
  fine_location_permission INTEGER,
  background_location_permission INTEGER,
  activity_recognition_permission INTEGER,
  battery_optimization_exempt INTEGER,
  background_restricted INTEGER,
  network TEXT NOT NULL,
  network_validated INTEGER,
  power_save_mode INTEGER,
  pending_records INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_safety_events INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  oldest_pending_age_ms INTEGER,
  location_age_ms INTEGER,
  ack_age_ms INTEGER,
  battery_pct INTEGER,
  charging INTEGER,
  recovery_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  position_available INTEGER NOT NULL,
  health_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  health_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  app_version TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
)

primary.name: idx_health_samples_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_health_samples_device_time
  ON device_health_samples(device_id, received_at DESC)

primary.name: health_incidents
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE health_incidents (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  severity TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ended_at INTEGER,
  alerted_at INTEGER,
  auto_recovered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  detail_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
)

primary.name: idx_health_incidents_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_health_incidents_device_time
  ON health_incidents(device_id, started_at DESC)

primary.name: idx_health_incidents_open
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_health_incidents_open
  ON health_incidents(device_id, ended_at, started_at DESC)

primary.name: crash_reports
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE crash_reports (
  report_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  app_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  module TEXT NOT NULL,
  exception_signature TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
)

primary.name: idx_crash_reports_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_crash_reports_device_time
  ON crash_reports(device_id, received_at DESC)

primary.name: audit_log
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  method TEXT NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  status INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  detail_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

primary.name: idx_audit_log_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_time
  ON audit_log(created_at DESC)

primary.name: device_replay_state
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_replay_state (
  device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  last_health_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: ble_anchors
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE ble_anchors (
  geofence_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  beacon_uuid TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(geofence_id) REFERENCES geofences(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_ble_anchors_device_uuid
primary.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ble_anchors_device_uuid
  ON ble_anchors(device_id, beacon_uuid)

primary.name: evidence_batches
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE evidence_batches (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  protocol INTEGER NOT NULL,
  record_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL,
  payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  r2_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, batch_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_evidence_batches_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_batches_device_time
  ON evidence_batches(device_id, received_at DESC)

primary.name: evidence_records
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE evidence_records (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider INTEGER NOT NULL,
  family INTEGER NOT NULL,
  capability INTEGER NOT NULL,
  health INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quality INTEGER NOT NULL,
  independence_group TEXT NOT NULL,
  elapsed_realtime_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  wall_time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  first_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, epoch, sequence),
  UNIQUE(device_id, record_id),
  UNIQUE(device_id, record_id, epoch, sequence),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_evidence_records_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_records_device_time
  ON evidence_records(device_id, wall_time_ms DESC)

primary.name: idx_evidence_records_provider_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_records_provider_time
  ON evidence_records(device_id, provider, wall_time_ms DESC)

primary.name: idx_evidence_records_family_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_records_family_time
  ON evidence_records(device_id, family, wall_time_ms DESC)

primary.name: evidence_batch_records
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE evidence_batch_records (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, batch_id, record_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id, batch_id) REFERENCES evidence_batches(device_id, batch_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id, record_id, epoch, sequence)
    REFERENCES evidence_records(device_id, record_id, epoch, sequence) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: device_evidence_state
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_evidence_state (
  device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  last_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_received_at INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: evidence_provider_health
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE evidence_provider_health (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider INTEGER NOT NULL,
  capability INTEGER NOT NULL,
  health INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  last_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  observed_wall_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, provider),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: atlas_models
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE atlas_models (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  model_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  model_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'empty',
  r2_key TEXT,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, model_key),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: witness_authorizations
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE witness_authorizations (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  witness_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, witness_device_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(witness_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: ground_receivers
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE ground_receivers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  latitude REAL,
  longitude REAL,
  radius_m REAL,
  public_key_spki_b64 TEXT,
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: device_commands
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_commands (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  command_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  acknowledged_at INTEGER,
  result_json TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_device_commands_pending
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_device_commands_pending
  ON device_commands(device_id, status, created_at)

primary.name: refined_history_runs
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE refined_history_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  from_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  to_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  model_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  r2_key TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_refined_history_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_refined_history_device_time
  ON refined_history_runs(device_id, from_ms, to_ms)

primary.name: witness_aliases
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE witness_aliases (
  alias TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(alias)=16),
  child_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  slot INTEGER NOT NULL,
  valid_from_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  valid_to_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source_record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(child_device_id, slot),
  FOREIGN KEY(child_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_witness_alias_child_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_witness_alias_child_time
  ON witness_aliases(child_device_id, valid_from_ms, valid_to_ms)

primary.name: idx_witness_alias_expiry
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_witness_alias_expiry
  ON witness_aliases(expires_at)

primary.name: witness_sightings
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE witness_sightings (
  record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  alias TEXT NOT NULL,
  witness_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  child_device_id TEXT,
  observed_wall_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  witness_latitude REAL NOT NULL,
  witness_longitude REAL NOT NULL,
  witness_accuracy_m REAL NOT NULL,
  rssi INTEGER,
  tx_power INTEGER,
  proximity_allowance_m REAL NOT NULL,
  uncertainty_m REAL NOT NULL,
  authorised INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(witness_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(child_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_witness_sightings_alias_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_witness_sightings_alias_time
  ON witness_sightings(alias, observed_wall_ms DESC)

primary.name: idx_witness_sightings_child_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_witness_sightings_child_time
  ON witness_sightings(child_device_id, authorised, observed_wall_ms DESC)

primary.name: idx_witness_sightings_unresolved
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_witness_sightings_unresolved
  ON witness_sightings(authorised, child_device_id, received_at)

primary.name: ground_sightings
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE ground_sightings (
  receiver_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sighting_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  alias TEXT NOT NULL,
  child_device_id TEXT,
  observed_wall_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  receiver_latitude REAL NOT NULL,
  receiver_longitude REAL NOT NULL,
  receiver_radius_m REAL NOT NULL,
  rssi INTEGER,
  tx_power INTEGER,
  proximity_allowance_m REAL NOT NULL,
  uncertainty_m REAL NOT NULL,
  resolved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64),
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(receiver_id, sighting_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(receiver_id) REFERENCES ground_receivers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(child_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_ground_sightings_alias_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_ground_sightings_alias_time
  ON ground_sightings(alias, observed_wall_ms DESC)

primary.name: idx_ground_sightings_child_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_ground_sightings_child_time
  ON ground_sightings(child_device_id, resolved, observed_wall_ms DESC)

primary.name: idx_ground_sightings_received
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_ground_sightings_received
  ON ground_sightings(received_at)

primary.name: learned_place_models
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE learned_place_models (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  geofence_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  model_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  trusted_visits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_trusted_visit_ms INTEGER,
  last_match_ms INTEGER,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'learning',
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, geofence_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(geofence_id) REFERENCES geofences(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: phase5_refined_intervals
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE phase5_refined_intervals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  from_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  to_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  model_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_r2_key TEXT,
  refined_r2_key TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CHECK(to_ms >= from_ms),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_phase5_refined_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_phase5_refined_device_time
  ON phase5_refined_intervals(device_id, from_ms, to_ms)

primary.name: phase5_hypothesis_frames
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE phase5_hypothesis_frames (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  wall_time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  r2_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  refined_run_id TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, record_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_phase5_hypothesis_device_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_phase5_hypothesis_device_time
  ON phase5_hypothesis_frames(device_id, wall_time_ms)

primary.name: idx_phase5_hypothesis_unrefined
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_phase5_hypothesis_unrefined
  ON phase5_hypothesis_frames(device_id, refined_run_id, wall_time_ms)

primary.name: phase5_precise_endpoints
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE phase5_precise_endpoints (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  wall_time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  latitude REAL NOT NULL,
  longitude REAL NOT NULL,
  uncertainty_m REAL NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id, epoch, sequence),
  FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_phase5_precise_endpoint_time
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_phase5_precise_endpoint_time
  ON phase5_precise_endpoints(device_id, wall_time_ms)

primary.name: device_location_control
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_location_control (
  device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  desired_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (desired_enabled IN (0,1)),
  command_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_actual_enabled INTEGER CHECK (last_actual_enabled IS NULL OR last_actual_enabled IN (0,1)),
  last_actual_at INTEGER,
  last_acked_command_id TEXT, command_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', completed_at INTEGER, result_actual_enabled INTEGER CHECK (result_actual_enabled IS NULL OR result_actual_enabled IN (0,1)), result_success INTEGER CHECK (result_success IS NULL OR result_success IN (0,1)), result_reason TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_location_control_updated
primary.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_location_control_updated
  ON device_location_control(updated_at DESC)

primary.name: idx_devices_public_key_spki_unique
primary.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_devices_public_key_spki_unique
ON devices(public_key_spki_b64)

primary.name: device_live_track_control
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_live_track_control (
  device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  command_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  requested_active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (requested_active IN (0,1)),
  issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  command_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (command_status IN ('pending','completed','failed','expired')),
  last_actual_active INTEGER CHECK (last_actual_active IS NULL OR last_actual_active IN (0,1)),
  completed_at INTEGER,
  result_reason TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: device_wifi_schedules
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_wifi_schedules (
  id TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (enabled IN (0,1)),
  target_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_enabled IN (0,1)),
  local_minute_of_day INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (local_minute_of_day BETWEEN 0 AND 1439),
  days_mask INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (days_mask BETWEEN 1 AND 127),
  grace_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (grace_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id,id),
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: device_wifi_schedule_result
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_wifi_schedule_result (
  device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_enabled IN (0,1)),
  actual_enabled INTEGER CHECK (actual_enabled IS NULL OR actual_enabled IN (0,1)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  detail TEXT,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: device_capability_profile
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_capability_profile (
  device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  profile_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  profile_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: screen_time_daily
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE screen_time_daily (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  local_day TEXT NOT NULL,
  total_foreground_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  session_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(device_id,local_day),
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: commute_summaries
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE commute_summaries (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ended_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  distance_m REAL NOT NULL,
  duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  transport_mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode_confidence REAL NOT NULL,
  start_label TEXT,
  end_label TEXT,
  provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(device_id,started_at,ended_at),
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

primary.name: idx_commute_device_time
primary.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_commute_device_time ON commute_summaries(device_id,started_at DESC)

primary.name: provider_cache
primary.sql:
CREATE TABLE provider_cache (
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
